title: Puppy dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#f2b06b'/>
    <!-- belly patch lighter -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#ffdfae'/>
    <!-- back leg left -->
    <path d='M38 74 L34 90 Q34 94 39 94 L43 94 Q47 94 46 90 L44 76 Z' fill='#d9914d'/>
    <ellipse cx='39' cy='93' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#ffe9c9'/>
    <!-- back leg right -->
    <path d='M62 74 L66 90 Q66 94 61 94 L57 94 Q53 94 54 90 L56 76 Z' fill='#d9914d'/>
    <ellipse cx='61' cy='93' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#ffe9c9'/>
    <!-- raised front leg left (waving up) -->
    <path d='M36 54 Q26 48 24 38 Q23 34 27 33 Q31 32 33 36 Q36 45 42 50 Z' fill='#f2b06b'/>
    <ellipse cx='26' cy='35' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#ffe9c9'/>
    <!-- raised front leg right -->
    <path d='M64 54 Q74 48 76 38 Q77 34 73 33 Q69 32 67 36 Q64 45 58 50 Z' fill='#f2b06b'/>
    <ellipse cx='74' cy='35' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#ffe9c9'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='33' r='19' fill='#f2b06b'/>
    <!-- ears -->
    <ellipse cx='31' cy='26' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#b97434' transform='rotate(-20 31 26)'/>
    <ellipse cx='69' cy='26' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#b97434' transform='rotate(20 69 26)'/>
    <!-- muzzle -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#ffdfae'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='43' cy='30' r='3.5' fill='#3a2a55'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='30' r='3.5' fill='#3a2a55'/>
    <circle cx='44' cy='29' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='29' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='37' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3a2a55'/>
    <!-- mouth happy -->
    <path d='M50 40 Q50 45 44 45' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M50 40 Q50 45 56 45' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- tongue -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#ff7a8a'/>
    <!-- tail -->
    <path d='M68 58 Q80 54 78 44' stroke='#d9914d' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- sparkles of joy -->
    <path d='M20 14 L22 20 L28 22 L22 24 L20 30 L18 24 L12 22 L18 20 Z' fill='#ffe06b'/>
    <path d='M82 20 L83.5 24 L87.5 25.5 L83.5 27 L82 31 L80.5 27 L76.5 25.5 L80.5 24 Z' fill='#ffe06b'/>
  </g>
</svg>
